questions.q: A man said, "My mother's husband's only son is the father of your sister's brother." How is the man related to you?
questions.s:
Decoding symbols for Family Tree:

Step-by-step Relationship Analysis:

Breakdown the statement made by the man: "My mother's husband's only son is the father of your sister's brother."

  • "My mother's husband" refers to the man's Father.
  • "Father's only son" refers to the man himself (the speaker).
  • "Your sister's brother" refers to your Brother (or you, if you are male).
  • Now, replace the parts in the sentence: "I (the man) am the father of your Brother."

Consolidated Family Structure:

 

If the man is the father of your brother, he must also be your father.

Thus, the man is your Father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"

questions.q: Education is now placed under which list after the 42nd Amendment?
questions.s:
The correct answer is Concurrent List.

Key Points

  • The 42nd Amendment Act of 1976 is one of the most comprehensive amendments to the Indian Constitution. It brought about significant changes in various provisions.
  • One of the key changes was the transfer of Education from the State List to the Concurrent List.
  • By placing education in the Concurrent List, both the Union Government and the State Governments can legislate on matters related to education.
  • This amendment was aimed at achieving a uniform educational policy across the country, ensuring better coordination and implementation of educational reforms.
  • The Concurrent List is one of the three legislative lists under the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India. It contains subjects on which both the Union and State Governments can make laws.
  • Other important subjects in the Concurrent List include criminal law, marriage and divorce, bankruptcy, and forests.

Additional Information

  • Union List
    • The Union List contains subjects on which only the Parliament has exclusive powers to make laws.
    • Examples of subjects in the Union List include defense, foreign affairs, atomic energy, banking, and communications.
    • It is mentioned in the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution and includes 100 subjects.
  • State List
    • The State List contains subjects on which only the State Legislatures have the authority to legislate.
    • Examples of subjects in the State List include police, public health, agriculture, and local government.
    • This list also falls under the Seventh Schedule and contains 61 subjects.

Find the part of the sentence that contains an error: 

That the report failed to address the root causes (1)/ of the community unrest were surprising (2)/ given the exhaustive data (3)/ compiled over several months. (4)
questions.s:
The correct answer is Option 2.
 
Key Points
  • The error lies in part (2) of the sentence due to incorrect subject-verb agreement.
  • The subject of the sentence is the entire noun clause: "That the report failed to address the root causes of the community unrest."
  • When a noun clause acts as the subject of a sentence, it is treated as a singular unit.
  • The plural verb "were" must be replaced by the singular verb "was" to match the singular subject.
Therefore, the correct answer is 2.
 
Correct Sentence: "That the report failed to address the root causes of the community unrest was surprising given the exhaustive data compiled over several months."
 
Additional Information
  • (1): "That the report failed to address the root causes" – This is the beginning of the noun clause and is grammatically sound.
  • (3): "given the exhaustive data" – This part correctly introduces the reason or evidence for the surprise.
  • (4): "compiled over several months." – This uses a past participle phrase correctly to modify the noun "data."

questions.q:
What is the difference of the largest and smallest of the given fractions? 

$\frac{5}{11}, \frac{5}{7}, \frac{3}{8}, \frac{6}{13}$
questions.s:
Formula used:

Average = Sum of all the term/Number of term

Calculation:

L.C.M. of 11, 7, 8, 13 = 8008

⇒ ($\frac{5}{11}, \frac{5}{7}, \frac{3}{8}, \frac{6}{13}$) × 8008

⇒ 11 × 120, 5 × 260, 7 × 195, 13 × 104

⇒ 3640, 5720, 3003, 3696

Least fraction = 3/8

Greatest fraction = 5/7

Difference = (5/7) - (3/8) = (40 - 21)/56 = 19/56

∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.

सुजाता की वर्तमान आयु का 6 गुना वनिता की वर्तमान आयु के 3 गुना से 6 वर्ष अधिक है। 7 वर्ष बाद, वनिता की आयु का 4 गुना सुजाता की आयु के 6 गुना से 6 वर्ष कम होगा। वनिता की आयु सुजाता की आयु से k वर्ष अधिक है। k का मान क्या है?

questions_hin.q_hi: Q27. Which of the following statements about the Indian Desert is correct? / भारतीय मरुस्थल के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है? [SSC CPO, 09 Dec 2025, Shift-2]
o_hi: The Indian Desert lies to the east of the Aravali Hills and receives moderate rainfall. / भारतीय मरुस्थल अरावली पहाड़ियों के पूर्व में स्थित है और यहाँ मध्यम वर्षा होती है।
It is a rocky plateau covered with dense forests and seasonal rivers. / यह घने जंगलों और मौसमी नदियों से ढका एक चट्टानी पठार है।
The region lies in the southern part of the Deccan Plateau and is rich in black soil. / यह क्षेत्र दक्कन के पठार के दक्षिणी भाग में स्थित है और यहाँ काली मिट्टी प्रचुर मात्रा में है।

The Indian Desert is an undulating sandy plain with sand dunes and receives less than 150 mm of rainfall annually.  / भारतीय मरुस्थल रेत के टीलों वाला एक लहरदार रेतीला मैदान है और यहाँ सालाना 150 मिमी से कम वर्षा होती है।
questions_hin.s_hi: The sprawling Great Indian Desert, famously known globally as the Thar Desert, is strategically located distinctly to the northwest of the prominent Aravalli Hills. It is geologically and officially defined precisely as a deeply dry, aggressively undulating sandy plain extensively covered entirely with massive shifting sand dunes, constantly receiving very scarce rainfall. / फैला हुआ ग्रेट इंडियन डेजर्ट, जिसे विश्व स्तर पर थार रेगिस्तान के रूप में जाना जाता है, रणनीतिक रूप से प्रमुख अरावली पहाड़ियों के उत्तर-पश्चिम में स्थित है। यह भूवैज्ञानिक और आधिकारिक तौर पर ठीक एक गहरे सूखे, आक्रामक रूप से लहरदार रेतीले मैदान के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है जो पूरी तरह से बड़े पैमाने पर बदलते रेत के टीलों से ढका हुआ है, जहाँ लगातार बहुत कम बारिश होती है।
